correction.previousClaim: Mobile uses visually distinct dedicated artwork from desktop.
correction.correctedFact: The source binds background.jpg at desktop and header_bg-small.jpg at mobile, but both current official responses are byte-identical 720x464 JPEGs with SHA-256 4fb7e2a72c046448d58d2d1bc6f0a9e5f61b9693ddcec5d117b59f881ec25976.
correction.interpretation: This is viewport-specific URL-role binding, not art-directed visual substitution.
correction.implementationRule: Implementation may preserve both observed URL roles or reuse the verified identical bytes. It must not claim or simulate a visual artwork change at the breakpoint.
correction.qaRule: Do not award responsive fidelity for a visible asset-identity change; validate the binding/provenance semantics and identical rendered artwork instead.
